modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs = class({})

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:CheckState()
    return {
        [MODIFIER_STATE_NO_HEALTH_BAR] = true,
    }
end

local function GetCacheValue(modifier, key)
    if IsServer() then
        return (modifier.final_cache_server and modifier.final_cache_server[key]) or 0
    end
    return (modifier.final_cache and modifier.final_cache[key]) or 0
end

local function SyncUnitBasics(unit, source)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not source or source:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if unit.SetBaseAttackTime and source.GetBaseAttackTime then
        unit:SetBaseAttackTime(source:GetBaseAttackTime())
    end
    if unit.SetAttackCapability and source.GetAttackCapability then
        unit:SetAttackCapability(source:GetAttackCapability())
    end
end

local function ResolveAttackRange(unit, source, range)
    local final = range or 0
    if final <= 0 then
        if source and source.GetAttackRange then
            final = source:GetAttackRange() or 0
        elseif unit and unit.GetAttackRange then
            final = unit:GetAttackRange() or 0
        end
    end
    if final <= 0 then
        final = 150
    end
    return final
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(modifier, unit, source, range, interval)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    SyncUnitBasics(unit, source)
    if modifier and modifier.UpdateAttackStats then
        local final_range = ResolveAttackRange(unit, source, range)
        modifier:UpdateAttackStats(final_range, interval)
    end
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:OnCreated(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    self.parent = self:GetParent()
    self.prevent_death = kv and kv.prevent_death or nil
    self.final_cache_server = {}
    self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:UpdateAttackStats(range, interval)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local bat = self.parent and self.parent:GetBaseAttackTime() or 1.7
    if not bat or bat <= 0 then
        bat = 1.7
    end

    local atk_speed = 0
    if interval and interval > 0 then
        atk_speed = (bat / interval - 1) * 100
    end

    self.final_cache_server = self.final_cache_server or {}
    self.final_cache_server.AttackRange = range or 0
    self.final_cache_server.AttackSpeed = atk_speed
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACK_RANGE_BASE_OVERRIDE,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_MIN_HEALTH,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_PERCENTAGE
    }
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetModifierAttackRangeOverride()
    return GetCacheValue(self, "AttackRange")
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetModifierAttackSpeedBonus_Constant()
    return GetCacheValue(self, "AttackSpeed")
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetMinHealth()
    if self.prevent_death then
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetModifierHealthRegenPercentage()
    return 10
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return self.final_cache_server or {}
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    self.final_cache = data or {}
end

return modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs

我理解：Shop1 的选中/拖拽/合成判定都是基于 `Shop1Managers[pid].Slots`，并且会做“单位是否在合法位置附近”的判断。现在需要在这个框架下，适配“代理单位可选、dummy不可选”的设计。

我建议改动点只围绕两个入口，保证 Slots 逻辑不变：
1) 选中事件（`libraries/selection.lua`）先把代理映射回主 dummy，再走 `FindSlotByDummy`。  
2) 订单拦截（`filters.lua`）同样把发起单位映射回主 dummy，再走现有拖拽/合成逻辑。  

这两个入口我已经加了 `ResolveShop1Dummy()` 映射。如果你还想加“根据位置判断是否在合法单位附近”的适配，请告诉我具体函数/条件是哪一段（比如 `FindNearestGoodSlot`/`FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos` 之外还有哪些判断），我再精准接入代理单位的坐标。

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameEnhance", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnEnhanceRequest then
                Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest({ PlayerID = pid })
            end
        end, "ToolMode Enhance", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("AddItemLevel", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            if not player then return end

            local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
            if not hero then return end

            Shop1Managers[pid]:AddItemLevel(hero)
        end, "ToolMode AddItemLevel", 0)
    elseif GameState.test then
        require('test_mode')
    end
end

function StartCustomGame(level)
    GameState.game_over_flag = false;
    GameState.game_start = true;

    print("[Game Start]")

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("game_start", {})

    GameState.start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    InitAllPlayerSpawnManagers()
    SelectionSpecial:Init()
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.Init then
        Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    end

    if IsInToolsMode() then
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
            if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
                local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
                if player then
                    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_mouse_bind", {})
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function EndCustomGame(result)
    -- print("[End]", GameState.game_over_flag, GameState.game_start)

    if GameState.game_over_flag then return end
    GameState.game_over_flag = true

    GameState.game_start = false

    print("[Game] EndCustomGame =>", result)

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        ClearAllGroundItems()
        ResetAllHeroes()

        for pid, mgr in pairs(SpawnManagers) do
            if mgr.StopAll then
                mgr:StopAll()
            end
        end

        PlayerStats:Clear()
        StatsManager:Clear()
        PlayerResourceExt:Clear()

        -- 3. 通知 UI
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("game_end", {
            result = result -- "win" / "lose"
        })
    end)
end

function ClearAllGroundItems()
    local drops = Entities:FindAllByClassname("dota_item_drop")

    for _, drop in pairs(drops) do
        if not drop:IsNull() then
            local item = drop:GetContainedItem()
            if item and not item:IsNull() then
                item:RemoveSelf()
            end
            drop:RemoveSelf()
        end
    end
end

function ResetAllHeroes()
    local heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes()
    if not heroes then
        return
    end

    local assigned = {}
    local assigned_count = 0
    for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
        if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
            if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                local entid = assigned_hero:entindex()
                if not assigned[entid] then
                    assigned[entid] = true
                    assigned_count = assigned_count + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    print("heros", assigned_count)

    for _, hero in ipairs(heroes) do
        if hero:IsRealHero() and not hero:IsTempestDouble() and not hero:IsClone() then
            local pid = hero:GetPlayerID()
            local heroName = hero:GetUnitName()

            -- print("[Shop1Managers]", pid, Shop1Managers, Shop1Managers[pid], hero, hero:GetUnitName())
            Shop1Managers[pid]:DestroyAllItems(hero)

            for i = 0, hero:GetAbilityCount() - 1 do
                local ability = hero:GetAbilityByIndex(i)
                if ability then
                    hero:RemoveAbilityByHandle(ability)
                end
            end

            local modifiers = hero:FindAllModifiers()
            for _, mod in pairs(modifiers) do
                mod:Destroy()
            end

            hero:Stop()

            -- 2. 关闭自动攻击
            hero:SetIdleAcquire(false)
            hero:SetAcquisitionRange(0)

            -- 3. 清空当前攻击目标
            hero:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)

            -- 4. 直接 Kill（非常重要）
            hero:ForceKill(false)

            local newHero = PlayerResource:ReplaceHeroWith(pid, heroName, 0, 0)

            Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
                if newHero and not newHero:IsNull() then
                    local spawn = PlayerSpawnPoint[pid]
                    if spawn then
                        local pos = spawn:GetOrigin()
                        FindClearSpaceForUnit(newHero, pos, true)
                        print("Respawn", pos)
                        newHero:SetOrigin(pos)
                    end

                    newHero:Stop()
                    if SpawnWallManager and SpawnWallManager.ResetPlayer then
                        SpawnWallManager:ResetPlayer(pid, newHero)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        local keep = {}
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
            if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
                local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
                local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
                if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                    keep[assigned_hero:entindex()] = true
                end
            end
        end

        local all_heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes() or {}
        for _, unit in ipairs(all_heroes) do
            if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:IsRealHero()
                and not unit:IsTempestDouble() and not unit:IsClone() and not unit:IsSpiritBearCustom()
                and not keep[unit:entindex()] then
                if UTIL_Remove then
                    UTIL_Remove(unit)
                else
                    unit:RemoveSelf()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

PlayerSpawnPoint = {}

function AssignSpawnPoint(pid)
    if PlayerSpawnPoint[pid] then
        return
    end

    local team = PlayerResource:GetTeam(pid)
    local name = team == DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
        and "info_player_start_goodguys"
        or "info_player_start_badguys"

    local spawns = Entities:FindAllByClassname(name)

    --print(team, name, #spawns)

    if #spawns == 0 then
        spawns = Entities:FindAllByClassname("info_player_start")
    end

    PlayerSpawnPoint[pid] = spawns[(pid % #spawns) + 1]
end

    -- for i = 0, hero:GetAbilityCount() - 1 do

    local spawn_point = PlayerSpawnPoint[playerID]

        hero:SetOrigin(pos

    if (HeroBaseStatsKV and HeroBaseStatsKV[hero_name]) then

        for key, val in pairs(HeroBaseStatsKV[hero_name]) do

    -- local ability = hero:AddAbility("ability_default_projectile")

**设计与需求**
- Shop1 dummy 的交互不要求真正点到单位本体：点击位置或选中单位后，逻辑会判断是否靠近某个 Shop1 dummy 位置，命中即视为选中。

  - 选中时白框只显示一个（即代理单位的选择框）
  - 头像 UI 仍能切换到单位模型

**当前代码逻辑（关键路径）**
- 选中事件：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/selection.lua`  
  - 通过 `Shop1Managers[pid].Slots` 查找命中的 dummy/slot。
  - 已加入 `ResolveShop1Dummy()` 映射，代理单位会被解析回主 dummy，确保 Slots 逻辑仍成立。

- 指令拦截：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/filters.lua`  
  - MOVE / ATTACK / CAST 等指令进入后，会尝试把命中的实体映射回主 dummy，再走原有拖拽/合成逻辑。

- 复合单位表现与代理：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua`
  - 2/3 阶创建表现 dummy + 代理单位。

- 代理单位仅负责“选中白框与头像 UI”，逻辑上会被映射回主 dummy。

@@
-function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
+function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
@@
     if count == 1 then
         positions[1] = center_pos
     elseif count == 2 then
         positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
         positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
     elseif count == 3 then
         positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
         positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
         positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
     end
 
     if positions[1] then
         self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
     end
@@
     if count > 1 then
         local max_dist = 0
         for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
             local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
             if dist > max_dist then
                 max_dist = dist
             end
         end
         self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
         SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
         if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
             SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, true)
         end
+        if self.worldPanel then
+            self.worldPanel:Delete()
+            self.worldPanel = nil
+        end
+        self:EnsureStarWorldPanelAtPos(center_pos)
     else
         self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
         SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
         if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
             SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, false)
         end
+        if not self.worldPanel then
+            self:EnsureStarWorldPanel()
+        end
     end
     return positions[1]
 end
@@
 function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanel()
@@
     self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
         layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/shop1_dummy_level.xml",
         entity = self.dummy,
         entityHeight = 100,
@@
     if not self.worldPanel then
         print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
     end
 end
+
+function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanelAtPos(pos)
+    if not pos then
+        return
+    end
+
+    if not WorldPanels then
+        return
+    end
+
+    if self.worldPanel then
+        self.worldPanel:Delete()
+        self.worldPanel = nil
+    end
+
+    local level = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1, 6))
+    local stars = string.rep("★", level)
+
+    self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
+        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/shop1_dummy_level.xml",
+        position = pos,
+        positionHeight = 100,
+        horizontalAlign = "center",
+        verticalAlign = "bottom",
+        offsetY = -25,

+            stars = stars,
+            level = level,
+        },
+    })
+
+    if not self.worldPanel then
+        print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
+    end
+end

local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
local autocast_item_config = require("projectiles.autocast_item_config")

local function GetSafeTeamNumber(unit)
    local team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    if unit and unit.GetTeamNumber then
        team = unit:GetTeamNumber()
    end
    if not team or team < DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS or team > DOTA_TEAM_CUSTOM_8 then
        team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    end
    return team
end

local DummyPool = {}

local function GetRightVector(forward)
    if not forward then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local right = Vector(forward.y, -forward.x, 0)
    if right:Length2D() < 0.01 then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    return right:Normalized()
end

local function GetHullRadiusSafe(unit)
    if unit and unit.GetHullRadius then
        local r = unit:GetHullRadius()
        if r and r > 0 then
            return r
        end
    end
    return 24
end

local function GetFormationOffset(unit)
    local name = unit and unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or nil
    local kv = name and UnitsKV and UnitsKV[name] or nil
    local offset = kv and tonumber(kv.Offset) or 0

    print("[Formation Offset] ", name, kv, offset)

    if not offset then
        return 0
    end
    return offset
end

local function SetUnselectable(unit, enable)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if enable then
        if not unit:HasModifier("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable") then
            unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable", {})
        end
    else
        unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable")
    end
end

local function TakeDummyFromPool(name)
    local pool = DummyPool[name]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end
    while #pool > 0 do
        local dummy = table.remove(pool)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ReturnDummyToPool(name, dummy)
    if not name or not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    DummyPool[name] = DummyPool[name] or {}
    table.insert(DummyPool[name], dummy)
end

local function PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
        WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
    if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
        dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    if dummy.Stop then
        dummy:Stop()
    end
    dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    dummy:AddNoDraw()
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
end

modifier_item_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.lvl          = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
        self.custom_level = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

        local raw_kv = raw_kv_withlevel
        if raw_kv_withlevel and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetOverrideValues and ability.raw_name then
            local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
            local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name]
            local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level, base_item_kv)
            if overrides then
                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
                for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                    if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                        raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                    else
                        raw_kv[key] = value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.hero_name       = raw_kv.HeroName
        self.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then
            return
        end

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveLevel)
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSPLevel, "[HeroPassiveSP]")

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp_2 = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp_2, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2Level, "[HeroPassiveSP2]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

            if self.mod then

            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then

        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage then
            self.skill_base_damage = tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage or 0) or 0
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel

        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetFormationCount()
    local lvl = tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1
    if lvl == 2 then
        return 2
    end
    if lvl == 3 then
        return 3
    end
    return 1
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
            self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        end
        return
    end

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        local owner = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetOwner() or nil
        local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if proxy then
            proxy:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                proxy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not proxy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            if proxy.SetRenderMode then
                proxy:SetRenderMode(1)
            end
            if proxy.SetRenderAlpha then
                proxy:SetRenderAlpha(0)
            end
            if HideWearables then
                HideWearables(proxy)
            end
            SetUnselectable(proxy, false)
            proxy.__shop1_proxy_dummy = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetEntityIndex() or nil
            self.selection_proxy = proxy
            if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then
            self.selection_proxy:SetHullRadius(max_radius)
        end
        if GoodForward then
            self.selection_proxy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    
    print("[高阶表现]", offset, r, s, h)

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, true)
        end
        if self.worldPanel then
            self.worldPanel:Delete()
            self.worldPanel = nil
        end
        self:EnsureStarWorldPanelAtPos(center_pos)
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, false)
        end
        if not self.worldPanel then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanel()
        end
    end
    return positions[1]
end

    if self.pid and self.slot then

        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode    = self.projectile_sp_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        local dummy = self.dummy
        self.dummy = nil
        if self.visual_dummies then
            for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
                if v and not v:IsNull() then
                    v:Destroy()
                end
            end
            self.visual_dummies = nil
        end
        dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
        ReturnDummyToPool("npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. tostring(self.lvl), dummy)
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        local dummy_sp = self.dummy_sp
        self.dummy_sp = nil
        PrepareDummyForPool(dummy_sp)
        ReturnDummyToPool("npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp", dummy_sp)
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanel()
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    if not WorldPanels then
        return
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    local level = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1, 6))
    local stars = string.rep("★", level)

    self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/shop1_dummy_level.xml",
        entity = self.dummy,
        entityHeight = 100,
        horizontalAlign = "center",
        verticalAlign = "bottom",
        offsetY = -25,
        data = {
            stars = stars,
            level = level,
        },
    })

    if not self.worldPanel then
        print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
    end
end

**Implementing single proxy selection enforcement**

payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/selection.lua
@@
     local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
     local entities = event.entities or {}
+    local proxy_ent = nil
+    local entity_count = 0
+    for _, entid in pairs(entities) do
+        entity_count = entity_count + 1
+        local unit_check = EntIndexToHScript(entid)
+        if unit_check and not unit_check:IsNull() and unit_check.__shop1_proxy_dummy then
+            proxy_ent = entid
+        end
+    end
+    if proxy_ent and entity_count > 1 then
+        Selection.ignore_next = Selection.ignore_next or {}
+        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = true
+        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, { proxy_ent })
+
+        local unit_proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxy_ent)
+        if unit_proxy and not unit_proxy:IsNull() and mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
+            unit_proxy = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_proxy)
+        end
+        local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_proxy)
+        if not slot or not data then
+            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
+            if player then
+                CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", { ability = "" })
+            end
+            return
+        end
+
+        local ability_name = ""
+        if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
+            local ability = data.Stats:GetAbility()
+            if ability then
+                ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
+            end
+        end
+        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
+        if player then
+            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", {
+                ability = ability_name
+            })
+        end
+        return
+    end

目前的处理基本符合设计，但还不算“最优且完全一致”，有两个点需要你确认：

已满足
- 可选性：复合时主 dummy / 表现 dummy / dummy_sp 不可选，代理可选。  
- 血条：主 dummy / dummy_sp / 表现 dummy 都在创建时挂了 `modifier_no_healthbar`，不会显示血条。  
- 选中逻辑：`selection.lua` 与 `filters.lua` 已映射代理 -> 主 dummy，不影响原合成/拖拽。

可能的缺口
1) 代理单位是否一定无血条  
   现在代理是创建时加 `modifier_no_healthbar`，但如果某处刷新/移除 modifier，可能露出血条。  
   如果要最稳，建议给代理也挂一个“永久无血条”的专用 modifier（或复用现有），并在创建/复合刷新时重贴。

2) 代理可选性在极端情况下可能被覆盖  
   目前 `SetUnselectable(proxy, false)` 是一次性清理。若后续有其它逻辑给代理加了不可选状态，会导致无法点选。  
   若想更稳，可以在 `EnsureSelectionProxy` 中每次刷新时确保代理没有 `modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable`。

- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua`

        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ReturnDummyToPool(name, dummy)
    if not name or not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    DummyPool[name] = DummyPool[name] or {}
    table.insert(DummyPool[name], dummy)
end

local function PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
        WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
    if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
        dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    if dummy.Stop then
        dummy:Stop()
    end
    dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    dummy:AddNoDraw()
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
end

modifier_item_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.lvl          = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
        self.custom_level = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

        local raw_kv = raw_kv_withlevel
        if raw_kv_withlevel and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetOverrideValues and ability.raw_name then
            local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
            local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name]
            local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level, base_item_kv)
            if overrides then
                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
                for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                    if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                        raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                    else
                        raw_kv[key] = value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.hero_name       = raw_kv.HeroName
        self.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then
            return
        end

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveLevel)
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSPLevel, "[HeroPassiveSP]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp_2 = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp_2, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2Level, "[HeroPassiveSP2]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, nil, self.hero_modifier_sp, {})
            if self.mod then
                print("[Hero Modifier SP]", self.mod:GetName())
            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then
            self.skill_pure_percent = BpToRatio(tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent))
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage then
            self.skill_base_damage = tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage or 0) or 0
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

        self.skill_listener = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_item_cast_listener", {
            ability_name = self.skill,
            dummy_index = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex(),
            level = self.skill_level,
            pure_percent = self.skill_pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetFormationCount()
    local lvl = tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1
    if lvl == 2 then
        return 2
    end
    if lvl == 3 then
        return 3
    end
    return 1
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
                tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
                tostring(selectable)))
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then

        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,

        )
        if proxy then
            local selectable = (proxy.IsUnselectable and not proxy:IsUnselectable()) or false
            print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][proxy] ent=%s selectable=%s",

                tostring(selectable)))
            proxy:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then

            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})

            -- end

            SetUnselectable(proxy, false)

            self.selection_proxy = proxy
            if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then
            self.selection_proxy:SetHullRadius(max_radius)
        end

        end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, true)
        end
        if self.worldPanel then
            self.worldPanel:Delete()
            self.worldPanel = nil
        end
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.selection_proxy)
        end
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, false)
        end
        if not self.worldPanel then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.dummy)
        end
    end
    return positions[1]
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    local dummy_name = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. self.lvl

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(parent)
    local pooled = TakeDummyFromPool(dummy_name)
    if pooled then
        self.dummy = pooled
        self.dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
        self.dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
        self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    else
        self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
            dummy_name,
            Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
            false,
            parent,
            parent,
            team
        )
    end

    if not self.dummy then
        return
    end

    local selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
    print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        tostring(selectable)))

    self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local dummy_level = Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(tonumber(self.lvl)) or 1

    if dummy_level > 1 then
        dummy_level = dummy_level - 1
        self.dummy:CreatureLevelUp(dummy_level)
    end

    if self.pid and self.slot then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid].Slots[self.slot].Dummy = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()
        local pos = Shop1Managers[self.pid] and Shop1Managers[self.pid]:GetGoodPointPos(self.slot)
        if not pos then
            local point = EntIndexToHScript(self.slot)
            if point then
                pos = point:GetOrigin()
            end
        end
        if pos then
            self.dummy:SetOrigin(pos)
        end
    end

    self.dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.dummy)

    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞

        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local right = Vector(forward.y, -forward.x, 0)
    if right:Length2D() < 0.01 then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    return right:Normalized()
end

local function GetHullRadiusSafe(unit)
    if unit and unit.GetHullRadius then
        local r = unit:GetHullRadius()
        if r and r > 0 then
            return r
        end
    end
    return 24
end

local function GetFormationOffset(unit)
    local name = unit and unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or nil
    local kv = name and AutocastDummyKV and AutocastDummyKV[name] or nil
    local offset = kv and tonumber(kv.Offset) or 0

    if not offset then
        return 0
    end
    return offset
end

local function SetUnselectable(unit, enable)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if enable then
        if not unit:HasModifier("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable") then
            unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable", {})
        end
    else
        unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable")
    end
end

local function TakeDummyFromPool(name)
    local pool = DummyPool[name]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end
    while #pool > 0 do
        local dummy = table.remove(pool)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ReturnDummyToPool(name, dummy)
    if not name or not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    DummyPool[name] = DummyPool[name] or {}
    table.insert(DummyPool[name], dummy)
end

local function PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
        WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
    if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
        dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    if dummy.Stop then
        dummy:Stop()
    end
    dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    dummy:AddNoDraw()
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
end

modifier_item_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.lvl          = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
        self.custom_level = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

        local raw_kv = raw_kv_withlevel
        if raw_kv_withlevel and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetOverrideValues and ability.raw_name then
            local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
            local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name]
            local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level, base_item_kv)
            if overrides then
                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
                for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                    if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                        raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                    else
                        raw_kv[key] = value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.hero_name       = raw_kv.HeroName
        self.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then
            return
        end

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveLevel)
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSPLevel, "[HeroPassiveSP]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp_2 = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp_2, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2Level, "[HeroPassiveSP2]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, nil, self.hero_modifier_sp, {})
            if self.mod then
                print("[Hero Modifier SP]", self.mod:GetName())
            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then
            self.skill_pure_percent = BpToRatio(tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent))
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage then
            self.skill_base_damage = tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage or 0) or 0
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

        self.skill_listener = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_item_cast_listener", {
            ability_name = self.skill,
            dummy_index = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex(),
            level = self.skill_level,
            pure_percent = self.skill_pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetFormationCount()
    local lvl = tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1
    if lvl == 2 then
        return 2
    end
    if lvl == 3 then
        return 3
    end
    return 1
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
            self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        end
        return
    end

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        local owner = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetOwner() or nil
        local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
